required_fixes: Fix spec.json seed_candidates: add expected_authors for WebCoach (currently []), ReasoningBank (currently []), and Pink et al. (currently ['Pink'] but should include all authors). C3 is unevaluable without expected authors.

Define domain_keywords for construction-seeded candidates appropriate to web-agent systems. Current C4 uses PC-COST-ACCOUNTING keywords ["agent", "memory", "replay", "screen", "activity", "deterministic"] which are specific to the Activity Frames paper, not general web-agent persistent-state systems. Agent Workflow Memory fails with 3/6 because it lacks "replay", "screen", "activity", "deterministic".

Complete the bounded 1-hop snowball via Semantic Scholar Graph API (retry with rate limiting, alternative API key, or cached responses). The snowball is a mandatory population component per spec.json identity_resolution.snowball (max_candidates=20, frozen_at_design=true). HTTP 429 infrastructure failure blocked up to 20 candidates from PC references.

Add a web-agent system positive control that persists state across sessions (e.g., Agent Workflow Memory arXiv:2409.07429) to validate identity gate sensitivity for the target construct. Current PC-COST-ACCOUNTING validates field extraction but is a cost-accounting paper, not a web-agent system.

Revise frozen decision_rule to account for mandatory population component infrastructure failure. Current MEASUREMENT_INVALID triggers (PC fail, NC fail, >50% substrate probes) do not include "snowball blocked by API failure" even though snowball is a frozen design component (spec.json identity_resolution.snowball.frozen_at_design=true).
validity_findings: VF1: PC-COST-ACCOUNTING (arXiv:2608.05784v1, Activity Frames) is a cost-accounting paper, NOT a web-agent system. It validates the field-extraction pipeline (correctly extracts modeled_vs_measured=modeled_explicitly_stated, break_even_reuse_count_fstar=NOT_REPORTED_AS_A_COMPUTED_QUANTITY) but does NOT validate identity gate sensitivity for the target construct (web-agent systems that persist state). The positive control validates the wrong construct.

VF2: All 5 seed candidates that ARE web-agent systems or memory papers fail the identity gate: Agent Workflow Memory (2409.07429) C4=3/6; Pink et al. Episodic Memory (2502.06975) C4=3/6; WebCoach (2511.12997) C3=unevaluable (no expected_authors), C4=3/6; ReasoningBank (2509.25140) C3=unevaluable, C4=3/6. The C4 domain keywords ["agent", "memory", "replay", "screen", "activity", "deterministic"] are frozen from PC-COST-ACCOUNTING and mismatch the target construct.

VF3: Identity gate has demonstrated specificity (NC-REAL-BUT-WRONG correctly emits AMBIGUOUS->UNMEASURED via C4 failure) but has NOT demonstrated sensitivity for any web-agent system with persistent state. Zero web-agent systems pass the gate in this experiment.

VF4: Snowball component (bounded 1-hop from PC references via Semantic Scholar Graph API) completely blocked by HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests). spec.json identity_resolution.snowball.frozen_at_design=true with max_candidates=20. This is a mandatory population component failure, not optional. Producer correctly classifies as infrastructure failure in validity_notes[189] and unresolved[197].

VF5: Frozen decision_rule (spec.json decision_rule.part_A_primary.outcome_MEASUREMENT_INVALID) triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID only if: PC-COST-ACCOUNTING fails identity, OR NC-REAL-BUT-WRONG resolves to RESOLVED or emits NOT_FOUND, OR >50% substrate probes fail. Snowball infrastructure failure is NOT a trigger. Producer status=COMPLETE/outcome=FALSIFIES follows frozen rule but ignores known population incompleteness.

VF6: Producer concludes outcome=FALSIFIES (universal) but report.md section 5.2 explicitly states: "No published web-agent system exists that reports a measured f*. The snowball was blocked by infrastructure failure. Agent Workflow Memory... is a web-agent system that clearly persists state across sessions... but it fails C4... This is a population incompleteness issue, not evidence of absence." The universal FALSIFIES overreaches the evidence.

VF7: WebCoach (arXiv:2511.12997) explicitly describes persistent cross-session memory and external memory stores (per producer unresolved[202]) but cannot be resolved due to spec.json seed_candidates missing expected_authors and C4 keyword mismatch. Agent Workflow Memory (arXiv:2409.07429) "induces reusable workflows from agent trajectories" (producer unresolved[200]) but fails C4.

VF8: spec.json seed_candidates for WebCoach and ReasoningBank have expected_authors: [] (empty list), making C3_author_substring unevaluable by design. Pink et al. has expected_authors: ["Pink"] but the paper has multiple authors ("Pink et al."). This is a frozen design defect in spec.json.
baseline_findings: BF1: B-PUBLISHED-NUMBERS-ONLY correctly observed - read-only extraction from published artifacts, no reproduction or SPIDER measurements. Pass=true in controls.

BF2: B-NULL-FUZZY-RECALL not executed due to Semantic Scholar infrastructure unavailability (same HTTP 429). Baseline designed as negative control for construction-vs-recall comparison. Producer records pass=not_applicable. This baseline cannot serve its intended comparative function.

recomputed_metrics.seed_4_fail_reason: C3: no expected authors; C4: 3/6 domain keywords
recomputed_metrics.seed_5_fail_reason: C3: no expected authors; C4: 3/6 domain keywords

claim_ceiling: On the construction-seeded population of 5 seed candidates (all failing identity gate) and 0 snowball candidates (blocked by Semantic Scholar API HTTP 429 infrastructure failure), zero RESOLVED candidates report a measured break-even reuse count f* with denominator/convention/uncertainty or a measured stationarity metric. The identity gate has demonstrated specificity (NC-REAL-BUT-WRONG correctly rejected) but has NOT demonstrated sensitivity for any web-agent system with persistent state (Agent Workflow Memory, WebCoach explicitly fail). The universal FALSIFIES conclusion is not justified; the maximum justified claim is FALSIFIES on the incomplete construction-seeded population only. The question of whether any published web-agent system reports a measured f* remains open pending snowball completion and identity gate sensitivity validation.

Domain keyword appropriateness: C4 keywords frozen from PC-COST-ACCOUNTING (activity, frames, agent, memory, replay, compilation, deterministic) may not be appropriate for general web-agent persistent-state systems.
